import sys
import re

def main():
    line = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    final_count = 0
    if line:  # not None and not empty
        pattern = re.compile(r'(.)\1*')
        seq_counter = 1
        for match in pattern.finditer(line):
            seq_counter += len(match.group()) - 1
            if seq_counter % 2 == 0:
                final_count += 1
                seq_counter = 1
    print(final_count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
